name: tmux-remote-control
description: Compose input locally and send it to the focused pane of a remote tmux session

scripts.check: bash -n bin/tmux-remote-control install-pi-extension.sh && for file in bin/*.mjs; do node --check "$file" || exit; done
scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.mjs && bash test/tmux-remote-control.test.sh && python3 test/history-pty.test.py
